name: Avatar
description: A person's picture in five sizes, with initials on a soft tint when there is none, a status dot, and overlapping groups.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture. When it is missing or fails to load, initials are shown instead.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: the accessible label, the source of the initials, and the seed for their tint.

props.name: size
props.description: 20, 24, 32, 40 or 56 pixels. Inside an AvatarGroup the group's size wins.

props.name: shape
props.description: A circle, or a rounded square whose corner follows its size.

props.name: status
props.description: A dot at the lower right in pine, yuzu, camellia or grey-blue, ringed in the page colour. Added to the accessible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of a span.

props.name: max
props.description: Avatars shown before the rest collapse into a "+N" tile.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every avatar in the group.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar elements. Each gets a ring in the page colour where it overlaps the one before.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of a div; give it an aria-label.
